stage_spec.description: carry legs 0..7 and the destination set-down in one run from a teacher-lifted beam (no re-staging)

rerun_rule: PREREG_DRAFT sec.8: HOST_ERROR case rerun once, same placement/seed, original record preserved

coarse_order_sheet.source: coarse order sheet (setup pose rounded to the sheet grid; static, fixed before the run)

r1.source: recorded PF posterior of an earlier stage (weighted particle mean / spread from stage_stop.npz)
r1.convention: std_xy_m = sqrt(var_x + var_y) as in PoseReport; per-axis std = std_xy_m / sqrt(2)

r2.source: recorded PF posterior of an earlier stage (weighted particle mean / spread from stage_stop.npz)
r2.convention: std_xy_m = sqrt(var_x + var_y) as in PoseReport; per-axis std = std_xy_m / sqrt(2)

coarse_order_sheet.source: coarse order sheet (setup pose rounded to the sheet grid; static, fixed before the run)

r1.source: recorded PF posterior of an earlier stage (weighted particle mean / spread from stage_stop.npz)
r1.convention: std_xy_m = sqrt(var_x + var_y) as in PoseReport; per-axis std = std_xy_m / sqrt(2)

r2.source: recorded PF posterior of an earlier stage (weighted particle mean / spread from stage_stop.npz)
r2.convention: std_xy_m = sqrt(var_x + var_y) as in PoseReport; per-axis std = std_xy_m / sqrt(2)
